description: External (non-bitFlyer) crypto reference OHLCV series used across research scripts as a liquid-market cross-check / regime feature: Binance BTCUSDT and XRPUSDT (klines at 1m/4h/1d, a full-precision 1m dump, and five rolling 1-second trade-bucket windows used around storm/burst events), plus bitbank xrp_jpy 1-minute candles (JPY-quoted, for BTC/XRP cross-checks against bitFlyer's own XRP_JPY). Distinct from schema/binance_daily.json (daily-mean derivatives metrics, dashboard-only) and schema/candles_fx_btc_jpy.json (bitFlyer's own products).
source: Binance klines: data-api.binance.vision public REST /api/v3/klines (BTCUSDT/XRPUSDT, no key, no geo-block) -- see scripts/fetch_external.py (1m/4h/1d) and scripts/fetch_binance_full.py (1m_full, 1s_* rolling windows). bitbank_xrp_jpy_1m.csv: public.bitbank.cc /{pair}/candlestick/1min/{day} -- see scripts/fetch_external.py.
retention: data/*.csv files are appended forward and merged with existing history on every fetch run (never truncated -- see scripts/fetch_external.py's save()). backtest_data/binance_BTCUSDT_1m.csv, binance_BTCUSDT_1m_210d_<date>.csv.gz, binance_XRPUSDT_*.csv and bitbank_xrp_jpy_1m.csv are permanent dated/frozen snapshots of the corresponding data/ file for reproducibility.

n_trades.meaning: number of trades in the bar

taker_buy_base.meaning: taker-buy base-asset volume in the bar

n_trades.meaning: number of trades in the bar

taker_buy_base.meaning: taker-buy base-asset volume in the bar

price.meaning: last trade price in the second

volume.meaning: summed trade volume in the second

quality._notes: 5 rolling windows share this shape: 1s_hi1/1s_hi2 (high-volatility reference windows), 1s_lo1/1s_lo2 (low-volatility reference windows), 1s_today (current-day rolling window) -- see scripts/fetch_binance_full.py for the exact window selection.

known_defects: these are external reference feeds, never a trading signal for the bitFlyer FX_BTC_JPY bot directly -- used only for cross-venue lead-lag / regime research (per CLAUDE.md's cross-border momentum research line)

the 1s_hi1/hi2/lo1/lo2/today windows are short, purpose-selected slices (high-vol / low-vol / current-day reference), not a continuous 1-second history -- large inter-file gaps against each other are by design, not a collection failure

binance_BTCUSDT_1m_full.csv carries extra precision columns (quote_volume/n_trades/taker_buy_base) that binance_BTCUSDT_1m.csv does not -- the two are not simply the same data at different retention, they come from two different fetch scripts (fetch_external.py vs fetch_binance_full.py) and are not guaranteed to be bar-for-bar identical on open/high/low/close rounding

DATA QA 2026-09-05 (docs/DATA_QA_TRIAGE.md): binance_BTCUSDT_1m_210d_*.csv.gz's missing_columns (5 hits: declared_but_absent=[timestamp], undocumented_in_schema=[open_time,quote_volume,n_trades,taker_buy_base]) was a schema bug, not a real header mismatch -- the actual file (verified: `zcat backtest_data/binance_BTCUSDT_1m_210d_20260820.csv.gz | head`) has header `open_time,open,high,low,close,volume,quote_volume,n_trades,taker_buy_base`, identical to fetch_binance_full.py's full-precision output shape (scripts/fetch_binance_full.py lines 10-17/37-38/98), NOT the plain `timestamp,open,high,low,close,volume` shape this schema previously declared for it. This 210-day snapshot is a frozen copy of the full-precision builder's output (data/binance_BTCUSDT_1m_full.csv), just under a retention-window-named filename instead of `_full` -- fixed by copying binance_BTCUSDT_1m_full.csv's column set into this file_group's `columns`/`unique_key`.

DATA QA 2026-09-05: extreme_return (91 hits across binance_XRPUSDT_1d.csv/4h.csv and binance_BTCUSDT_1d.csv, mirrored in both data/ and backtest_data/ copies of the same files -- 5 unique files total) checked against real crypto price history: XRP moves of +13%/+12%/+15%/+26%/+13% and BTC moves of +10%/-14%/+12% in a single bar are within the well-documented volatility of both assets (XRP in particular has repeated >20%/day pumps historically) -- no evidence of a decimal/unit/duplicate-row artifact (values are internally consistent bar-to-bar, not a single spurious spike). Judged genuine market moves, not a collection defect.

DATA QA 2026-09-05: maintenance_window (355 hits, both copies of bitbank_xrp_jpy_1m.csv) is a false application of a bitFlyer-specific check to a different exchange -- bitbank has no relationship to bitFlyer's 19:00-19:10 UTC downtime, so a flat (O=H=L=C) minute landing in that same clock window there is coincidental illiquidity in a thin JPY-quoted altcoin pair, not a carried-forward maintenance artifact (confirmed neighboring minutes are NOT identical to each other, just individually flat -- e.g. 172.665 -> 172.642 -> 172.642 -> 172.642 -> 172.694, real small moves with occasional zero-range minutes). Disabled dataset-wide via `quality.skip_checks: [maintenance_window]` since none of this dataset's sources are bitFlyer.

DATA QA 2026-09-05: zero_volume (19,435 hits, both copies of bitbank_xrp_jpy_1m.csv) is expected at 1-minute granularity for a thin JPY-quoted altcoin pair (bitbank XRP/JPY), the same pattern already established for schema/n225f_225labo.json's 1-minute zero_volume and schema/reit_onr.json's early-listing zero_volume -- not actioned.
